advancedgenetics:*_matter.why: Scraped from a living mob, which is never used up; the cheapest scalpel (iron, 25 uses) costs about 21 EMC per scrape, so every matter is worth 16 whatever the mob, which keeps scraping from creating EMC.

conversions.name: cell_analyzer
conversions.why: The cell analyzer turns one organic matter into the matching cell (a custom recipe type ProjectE cannot map).

conversions.name: dna_extractor
conversions.why: The DNA extractor turns any cell into one DNA helix; the gene lives in NBT, which transmutation does not copy.

processes.name: metal_scalpel_scrapes
processes.why: An iron scalpel lasts 25 scrapes, each giving one matter of the scraped mob.

processes.name: decrypt_dna
processes.why: The DNA decrypter marks a helix as decoded, one in, one out.

notes: Genes such as Emerald Heart, Lay Egg, Milky, Wooly and Meaty make vanilla items renewable on a cooldown; that is gene balance, not an EMC value, and is left to the pack's gene configuration.
